prompt:

The attached reference shows FOUR historical views of this SAME ONE Small Seal character ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC; some may be marked unavailable. Compare ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally to understand its identity. Create exactly ONE new independent, harmonious, contemporary monoline Gothic redraw informed by all witnesses, not a copy of one source and not a four-glyph grid. Preserve every essential branch, crossing, counter, attachment and separation. If variants disagree, choose one coherent attested whole structure, never combine incompatible components or substitute modern Chinese.
Output ONLY the ONE glyph in pure black on alpha transparency, large and centered within the central 70% of square canvas, generous margins, no background/text/labels/border/grid. Reconstruct the real intentional stroke courses as clean continuous centerlines, smooth rounded geometric curves and straight lines. Every stroke must have equal CONSTANT width about 4% of EM, with round end caps and joins, no brush taper, contrast, serifs, texture, blobs, doubled outlines, swelled intersections or decorative seal effects. Right component is NOT a modern Chinese replacement: an upper open-left-ish rounded rectangular turn with a top bar, a vertical spine down its middle crossed by a mid-height bar, and a continuous meandering S-shaped lower stroke that turns downward and joins a flat bottom baseline. Preserve the two horizontal levels across its upper structure, the inward left return and the lower meander. Compare all four drawings carefully.
